sermon.title: Judgment and Condemnation — June 20, 2021
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: On Father’s Day a younger speaker compares pandemic rules to the gospel and says the gospel should be preached even if called judgmental. From 1 Corinthians 11 he teaches discerning the Lord’s body: holding the church, Jesus, His word and His blood distinct and highest, judging ourselves, and accepting God’s correction like David rather than Saul, before communion.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Captions read “Proverbs 33 11” (Proverbs 3:11) and “Ii Samuel 2 11” (2 Samuel 12:11).

This do, as often as you drink it, in remembrance of Me.” For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death till He comes.

None of them shall teach his neighbor, and none his brother, saying, ‘Know the LORD,’ for all shall know Me, from the least of them to the greatest of them. For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their lawless deeds I will remember no more.”

faqs.question: Why not give up meeting together?
faqs.answer: To encourage one another toward love and good deeds.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And let us consider one another in order to stir up love and good works, not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as is the manner of some, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.

faqs.question: What about ideologies in college?
faqs.answer: God’s word is higher than all of them.

faqs.question: How is Jesus like a spouse?
faqs.answer: You separate that person from everyone else and commit.

faqs.question: Is saying sorry enough?
faqs.answer: Not for Saul: “stuff your sorry’s in a sack,” as the speaker tells his kids.

faqs.question: What does the speaker observe in older believers?
faqs.answer: That God brought them through chastening and it yielded fruits of righteousness.

faqs.question: What were David’s sins?
faqs.answer: Adultery with Bathsheba and the murder of Uriah.

faqs.question: What did David’s sin give occasion to?
faqs.answer: For the enemies of the Lord to blaspheme.

scriptures.text_nkjv: However, because by this deed you have given great occasion to the enemies of the LORD to blaspheme, the child also who is born to you shall surely die.”

faqs.question: What is said about the COVID shot in the bread prayer?
faqs.answer: People identify with it to be made whole, but we identify wholeheartedly with the body of Christ.
